_comment: Per provider: task + difficulty (0/1/2) -> tier. targets.json translates the tier into an agent/model/effort/text. Claude answers trivial work inline (a subagent for it costs an extra main-model turn, a fresh context and reading the result back: more than it saves); `#haiku` still delegates to the fast tier. '+verify:<tool>' adds an independent cross-check via cli-bridge (Claude only). cloud_replace applies in a cloud sandbox (ROUTER_MODE=cloud or CLAUDE_CODE_REMOTE=true), where neither Codex/Antigravity logins nor the user-level generated agents exist.

cost_cap._comment: Cost-aware cap on the model family a Claude subagent may run on. max_family: difficulty level -> the highest family; by_task overrides it per task. A tier or a model JEV picked above the cap is lowered to it (an explicit #opus/#fable override is never capped). short_chat_chars / short_chat_max_family: a plain prompt shorter than this (no code, path or file name) never runs above that family (only for short_chat_tasks: a short integral is still math); inline stays inline.
